killedBy: hud.css is syntactically whole never centres the main axis of a pane that scrolls
why: The self-test's list is as tall as the connected hardware makes it -- a standard pad alone is 21 channel rows -- so centring the main axis of its scroll container puts the heading and the first pad above the scroll origin on the FIRST connected controller, not only on a short viewport. The sweep pins the centred set exactly, which is what makes a third pane joining it a red test.
